notes.title: Improved data reading process
notes.content:
Improved data reading process

This eliminates the freeze on the "Now Loading" screen.
However, a slight freeze will occur when reading terrain data after the start of the stage.

We may change it at a later date after deciding which is better.

notes.title: 0.18.4　Update
notes.content:
With this update, data such as flight battleships can be read from external files.
This allows you to bring your own airship into the game.

[url=https://hukurou91.com/mod%e3%81%ae%e4%bd%9c%e3%82%8a%e6%96%b9/]Click here[/url] for the method
